metadata.question: Does the surface reflectance of Lake Elton increase from 2004 to 2009?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Lake Elton (Russia, ~46.7°N, 45.1°E) - Collections: Landsat 5 TM (2004-2009 availability) - Date ranges: 2004 (full year) vs 2009 (full year) - Need to compare mean surface reflectance between these two periods 2. Masking strategy: - Use CFMASK or QA bands to mask clouds and shadows - Focus on water pixels (use NDVI or NDMI to isolate water) - Calculate mean reflectance for comparable bands (e.g., red or NIR) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - Check image counts for both years; if 0 images, return C1 - Check valid pixel counts after masking; if 0, return C2 - Check if reflectance values are within valid range (0-1 for Landsat); if None/NaN or out of range, return C3 - Compare: if 2009 reflectance > 2004 reflectance, answer A (yes), else B (no) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Lake Elton geometry const lakeElton = ee.Geometry.Point([45.1, 46.7]).buffer(15000); // 2. Acquire Landsat 5 TM data for 2004 and 2009 const col2004 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeElton) .filterDate('2004-01-01', '2004-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const col2009 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeElton) .filterDate('2009-01-01', '2009-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size2004 = col2004.size().getInfo(); const size2009 = col2009.size().getInfo(); if (size2004 === 0 || size2009 === 0) { console.log(`2004 Images: ${size2004}, 2009 Images: ${size2009}`); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Create median composites and apply cloud mask const maskClouds = (img) => { const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(32).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(64).eq(0)); return img.updateMask(cloudMask); }; const img2004 = col2004.map(maskClouds).median(); const img2009 = col2009.map(maskClouds).median(); // 4. Select red band (SR_B3) as surface reflectance proxy const ref2004 = img2004.select('SR_B3'); const ref2009 = img2009.select('SR_B3'); // 5. Calculate mean reflectance with pixel counts const stats2004 = ref2004.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: lakeElton, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2009 = ref2009.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: lakeElton, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean2004 = stats2004.getNumber('SR_B3_mean').getInfo(); const count2004 = stats2004.getNumber('SR_B3_count').getInfo(); const mean2009 = stats2009.getNumber('SR_B3_mean').getInfo(); const count2009 = stats2009.getNumber('SR_B3_count').getInfo(); // 6. Validation console.log(`2004: Mean=${(mean2004/10000).toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${Math.round(count2004)}`); console.log(`2009: Mean=${(mean2009/10000).toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${Math.round(count2009)}`); if (count2004 === 0 || count2009 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } if (mean2004 === null || mean2009 === null || isNaN(mean2004) || isNaN(mean2009)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // 7. Compare reflectance (normalized by 10000 for Landsat L2) const ref2004Norm = mean2004 / 10000; const ref2009Norm = mean2009 / 10000; if (ref2009Norm > ref2004Norm) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
